name: Quick Yogurt Naan
subtitle: Skillet naan from a Greek-yogurt dough, brushed with garlic butter
equipment: Cast iron or heavy 12-inch skillet with a lid, rolling pin, pastry brush or spoon

macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.

notes: Restaurant naan is a yeasted dough slapped onto the wall of a tandoor. This is the quick skillet version: baking powder and yogurt do the rising, so there's no proofing time. It's softer and less chewy than tandoor naan, but it blisters and puffs the same way if the pan is hot enough. The dough starts sticky, so flour your hands and the counter; the 15-minute rest relaxes the gluten so it rolls thin without springing back. Bread flour gives more chew than all-purpose. Leftovers: wrap tightly, then warm in a dry skillet 20–30 seconds per side.

items: 1½ cups bread or all-purpose flour, plus more for rolling

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.body: In a bowl, whisk **1½ cups flour + 2 tsp baking powder + ½ tsp kosher salt**. Stir in **1¼ cups Greek yogurt + 2 tsp olive oil** until shaggy, then knead in the bowl with floured hands about 1 min until it comes together in a soft, slightly tacky ball. Cover and rest **15 min**.

steps.title: Garlic butter
steps.body: While the dough rests: melt **1 Tbsp butter** in a small bowl in the microwave (20–30 seconds) and grate in **1 clove garlic**. Set the brush beside it.

steps.title: Roll
steps.body: Cut the dough into **8** pieces. On a well-floured counter, roll each into an oval or round about 7 inches across and thinner than ⅛ inch. Thin is what makes it puff. Lay them out on a floured surface without stacking.

steps.title: Staging check
steps.body: Within reach: rolled dough, the lid, tongs, a clean towel for stacking the cooked naan, the garlic butter and brush, a small bowl of water.

steps.title: Heat the pan
steps.body: Dry skillet over medium-high for **3 min**, until a flick of water skitters and evaporates almost instantly.

steps.title: Cook
steps.body: Wet your fingers and dab a little water on the top side of one naan, then lay it in the pan dry side down. Cover with the lid. Cook **1–1½ min** until bubbles rise and the bottom has dark spots. Flip, cover again, and cook **45–60 seconds** more. Brush with garlic butter, sprinkle with flaky salt if using, and stack under the towel. Repeat. If they scorch before puffing, turn the heat down a notch; if they stay pale and stiff, turn it up.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve warm. Stacked under the towel, they stay soft for 15–20 minutes.

source.label: Standard two-ingredient yogurt flatbread, cooked like skillet naan
